title.narrative: Strengthening M&E of the Poverty Reduction Strategy

description.narrative: The IDF grant is focused on improving the monitoring and evaluation of the Poverty Reduction Strategy (PRS) and is focused on three main activities: (i) ,,Assessment, and proposed refinements to the Monitoring and Evaluation System of the PRS - This component would identify the strengths and weaknesses of the existing M&E system, and based on this assessment, propos an action plan with proposed recommendations and a timeline developed to strengthen the M&E system for the PRSp. (ii) ,,Support to the Ministries of Education, Health and Infrastructure to refine their indicators, improve routine data collection and quality and improve sector policy analysis. (iii) Technical Assistance to Support Statistical Capacity Building and Capacity for Policy Analysis - This involves support primarily to INSTAT (Statistics Agency) and includes support to the development of a National Statistical master plan, drafting an updated legal framework for the statistical system; developing a data access protocol and improved user-producer interface; and capacity building in INSTAT, CREAM (policy research institute) to undertake and commission policy analysis. The objective of the grant is to provide support for strengthening the monitoring and evaluation for Madagascar's poverty reduction strategy (PRS), the Madagascar Action Plan (MAP). This is being done through three main activities (i) Assessment of, and Proposed Refinements, to the Monitoring and Evaluation System of the PRS. The expected outcome is an improved institutional environment for monitoring and evaluation and the use of the data collected in policy analysis. More concretely, this means better quality and relevance of reporting, a better definition of the roles and responsibilities of the different agencies involved in monitoring and evaluation, and an improved feedback between the data collected in the monitoring system and its use in detecting problems, and using that to facilitate a dialogue to solve them. (ii) The second activity includes support to the ministries of health, education and infrastructure to strengthen the monitoring and evaluation system to refine key indicators, improve routine data collection and quality, and improve sector policy analysis. The expected outcome is a strengthened results focus for the PRSP which should facilitate a better alignment of strategic objectives to budget allocations (iii) Technical Assistance to Support Statistical Capacity Building and Capacity for Policy Analysis. The likely outcome is enhanced local capacity for policy analysis and strategy formulation, which means that the local researchers would be able to undertake independent, relevant and good quality policy analysis.
